title: Schedule of Tow Notice Fee Levels for Repeat Notices, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Tow notice fee level — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.**

| Other notices of intent to tow sent on the agreement in the last 24 months | Fee level |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | $65.00 |
| exactly 1 | $55.00 |
| none | no adjustment under this schedule |

**Notes.**
1. "Other" notices are those besides the notice the fee is being posted for; that notice itself is not counted.
2. A window of the last 24 months covers entries dated less than 24 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month. A notice is placed in the window by its notice date.
3. The fee level is the figure the tow notice fee is worked from; it is the same for every space class.

**Hypothetical readings.**
- A notice sent today, with earlier notices of intent to tow 5 months and 19 months ago: 2 other notices, fee level $65.00.
- A notice sent today, with one earlier notice 11 months ago and another 30 months ago: 1 other notice inside the window, fee level $55.00.
- A notice sent today, with no earlier notice in 24 months: no adjustment under this schedule.
